dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Multiple thin, low-contrast horizontal tiers formed by pale feather fringes on the greater and median coverts, rather than distinct, thick bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness; prominent pale edges create distinct linear contrast against the dark bodies of the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and non-linear; the color transition between the crown and mantle lacks a sharp, distinct boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-contrast, repetitive 'scaly' pattern across the entire dorsal surface, created by dark feather centers and bright white/pale fringes.
